projects.name: Shuttle delays in the Hajj season
projects.description: Downloaded two months of shuttle-bus trip records from a government open data portal, cleaned the data by removing blank and repeated rows and fixing inconsistent time formats, summarized delays by hour and route using pivot tables, created three charts showing delay patterns after Isha prayer, calculated average and median delays per route, and wrote a four-page report presented to the class.

experience.title: Treasurer
experience.description: Maintained the club budget in a shared spreadsheet using formulas to total spending per event and reported the balance to members each month.

experience.title: Hajj season volunteer
experience.description: Guided pilgrims at a shuttle station in Mina for twelve days, which inspired the course project on shuttle delays.
